content: I have been an Amazon customer for YEARS. I never had a problem with the Amazon app. Sure, it was glitchy sometimes, but I could get past it. Now, I can't even load my lists from before, and nothing saves to my favorites. When I click to go back to my cart, it just goes back to the last page I was on. It is so frustrating because I had everything organized and ready to save to favorites so I could move things to organized lists. Now, I can't do that because of this stupid update. Fix it.

For the last 30 days or more I can only navigate the app for maybe a few minutes then the pages won't fully load. Then after a bit I cannot type anything in the search bar, the keyboard won't even pop up. After a bit longer the app crashes. If I back out to look at another app and go back it's completely unusable and crashes. I can order and it goes through but has to be done within 3-4 minutes before it crashes. This happens on every use of the app.

Although I absolutely LOVE the company and the fast service it provides, I must include the app is 60% usable on a good day. Want to see all the pics of an item past the first pic? Incoming app freeze for 2 mins, and thats with WiFi via 1gbs cable. All other apps run flawlessly compared to this one. Its literally a put-down to search for stuff, as you rather wait and go home to use the pc to see everything without cpu/poorly optimized, or whatever is causing this app to act like it does. Shame

Experience had gotten better but lately, they have dropped the ball again. I've learned when I make a larger order for next day. It doesn't show up on time but takes several days. I get large orders can take time, but don't say the item can make it the next day, if it can't make it the next day. Use AI or something to correct time for deliveries that are large orders.

Too many sponsored irrelevant items. About 40-60% of the items are the same exact items that is not what I am looking for. Also, search bar is not funtional due to its auto correction, which you cannot disable. AI completely ruined shopping experience. Besides, item quality is so bad on amazon nowadays while they charge more than double for items or sell in bulk, encouraging unnecessary consumerism.

Edit: issues persist. My main problem: every time you tap on something and attempt to return to the main "sales feed", the whole feed resets and you can't continue looking at the same things your were looking at before. The 2nd thing: if I refresh the feed intentionally, how about showing me something I haven't already seen. I'm not refreshing because I want to look at the same items. 3rd thing: Trash items everywhere. Absolutely no integrity. But everyone knows that about Amazon already.

Rufus pisses me off, useless answers he can't answer it usually, bring back the original search for questions and comments on a certain product! Bottom tab is in the way and just clutters the page. I do a lot of shopping on Amazon, I have a lot of lists to organize items and it takes forever to access my list of lists!! The layout is a joke, I don't use Alexa and I can't remove that option off my list. I love shopping on Amazon, but app SUCKS. I wish it would go back to the way it was years ago.

I love the free two day shipping with Prime and being able to watch movies and TV shows for free on our TCL Roku TV app. Edit: The unresponsiveness of the app hasn't been a problem for a long time now, 5 years after I wrote this review. I would have given it 5 stars this time but the Rufus AI added from a recent update that comes up at the bottom of the screem every product you look at is annoying. Having the option to turn it off in settings would be great.

I really hate the new AI feature ("Rufus"). The fact that there's no setting to even just disable it is absolutely ridiculous, and dismissing it is largely ineffective because it pops back up if you want to look at a different version of the same product (switching colors of an article of clothing, for instance). I don't understand the reasoning behind why this feature is essentially mandatory for people who don't want it/find it annoying.

Love shopping on Amazon! However it frustrates me to no end with the "view similar" or "you might like" when searching for car parts because 9/10x the recommendation DOESN'T FIT MY VEHICLE! Then why are you showing it to me? Grrr. Also in the "Deals for me" portion...show me the actual price NOT the percentage off. I spend more wasted time realizing after clicking the offer that 30-35% off is ONLY worth $2 maybe $3 off retail ... And I spend that in taxes on the order. Otherwise great app!

Too many of my orders are late or never delivered. They've sent me an empty package at least once. I used to shop almost exclusively through Amazon, and now I have to cancel my account because it doesn't make sense to pay for a subscription that literally does not deliver on their end. I blame the driver, but they ultimately work for amazon, so there it is.

I liked scrolling through different items and the colors offered, but the new chat bot has ruined my experience. I'm so tired of clicking on a different color and the chat popping up again, they should add an option that lets me turn the chat pop-up off. I'll ask it for help when I need help. I'd give it less than 1 star if I could.

For the second time, I tried to order from Amazon, but my account has been put on hold, and I was told by one of your associates that it's due to technical error. You people need to do better how can this happen twice on different mobiles . I really needed those items. I placed the order for,and this being my first time personally ordering from Amazon was a very bad experience .

LET ME DISABLE RUFUS. Its so annoying and just gets in the way, the amount of times I've accidently opened it while trying to scroll is ridiculous and its just all kinds of annoying to have to swipe out of it every. Single. Time. I open a new listing or even just look at a different colour in the same one! I DONT WANT YOUR STUPID AI

Please get rid of the new AI feature!! "Rufus" is so annoying, it pops up every time I view an item and I can't find a way to permanently turn it off. You have to swipe down to close it, not even on the sides of the pop-up window but directly down the middle which makes it even more irritating. Corporations think having AI makes their product more appealing but they forget that many consumers are still unfamiliar with this technology and find it unnecessary, especially for browsing Amazon.

Amazon's software quality has taken a nosedive.. I'm not sure how any of these features got past QA, but the quality of this app has sharply declined recently. I suspect it has to do with their AI, Rufis, implementation, but I've gotten frequent slowdowns, unresponsiveness, crashes, wierd glitches where keystrokes aren't registering, even UI elements not fitting properly on the screen. Not to mention Rufus itself is always annoyingly on screen, popping up when I never wanted it at all..

The Rufus AI chatbot is the most irritating thing I have ever experienced in an app. It was something thrust upon me as a user and forces me to be a beta tester when I don't want it! There's no way to turn it off and it is not helpful. It takes up valuable space when you try to weed through search results and product descriptions while also popping up constantly when I don't need it to. I am beyond frustrated. The Amazon Prime service is nothing to brag about either...

This past year has been RIDICULOUS with delivery! BEFORE you order it gives you 1 date for delivery. AFTER you order it's a whole different date! Have called MANY times to complain and it's always "we will escalate and try to compensate". Hasnt happened. All year, almost every order. I have even been taking screenshots of before and after ordering dates!!! About to be canceling my membership!!!

I don't want delivery is done on Sunday I find it offensive for more than one reason personal and professional. If this is a business that is trying to facilitate my needs I should have the option not to have Sunday delivery. I also cannot see all of the price changes because you only give a one-time auction and it's impossible to find things that go on sale unless you get them on that one single screen because you get rid of both the scrolling bar and the table.

Crashes a lot since they added that AI garbology. On the plus side, you can ask it questions about things that have nothing to do with shopping, and it will answer. Seems like an odd trade-off. It was far better before, like 4 stars, but it's so hard to use now. They ought to have it disable AI if it detects itself crashing multiple times in the same day. It is truly a pointless "Look guys! We have the buzzword tech too!" feature.

What can I say, Amazon is amazing. The selection is mind boggling. I can find just about anything. Service is wonderful. They have their business dialed in darn near perfectly. It's a service that is relatively perfect even to someone who struggles with technology. I have made purchases from around the world. items I never would have imagined imagined that I could find or even know existed.

I use the Amazon Shopping app all the time. But, recently, they added an AI generated pop-up called "Rufus" that makes browsing so annoying!!! Every time I view an item, it pops up and blocks the bottom of my screen. I have to manually close it... every time I view an item. I hate this new "tool" they added. I hope they get rid of it, or at the very least, make it optional in the settings. I guess it's saving me money by causing me to browse less and thus cut down on compulsive buys. So 2 stars.

Total garbage. Amazon seems to pride themselves in the amount of items they do not deliver. They do not refund or replace items that Never show up. Now, they have made it impossible to dispute, return or refund anything. Do not download this app or purchase from Amazon no matter how convenient you may think it is. Just go buy it from your local store and tip you service person. Technology has everybody thinking it's easier, faster and cheaper when in reality you save by going shopping in person

I made the mistake of updating and now I've got Rufus peeking up at me with no way to disable it, stealing valuable screen space. Generative AI is a constant mess, yet here we are with companies STILL insisting on using it to steal data and provide false information. Uninstalling to go back to an older version without it that simply does what I ask it to do when I want it to do it. That's all anybody ever wants from tech. Edit 07/24: they brick old versions of the app, so downgraded to one star

No Dark Mode UI option. Totally unacceptable. You've got the technology ... the Prime Video portion of the app is Dark Mode. How about making it possible for the entire UI to have a Dark Mode option (and default to the system setting). And it does not work at all with the talkback screen reader. Once again this is totally unacceptable and pathetic.

If you actually get what you're ordering and not someone's garbage that they returned just to weigh down the package or a used item sold as new, it will probably be counterfeit. I have more faith ordering from Temu lately. Membership prices keep going up. The perks are becoming less and less, and anything worth watching on Prime video is an additional rental fee. I wish the feds would look into these guys for degradation of service.

I am getting to be quite a fan of the Amazon Reconditioned items, most are new returns, and there are some serious discounts on the products. The delivery is usually very prompt and if there's an issue, I've never had a problem with a return (within reason).I have had serious issues on FB Marketplace with fake vendors and bogus merchandise. Not here...

It mostly does what it's supposed to do, however at the moment there are two major issues that irritate me to no end. 1. It does not send me text alerts anymore and hasn't for some time now, only emails. 2. They need to get rid of the "inspire" tab/section that they recently added. It's clearly there for no reason other than to try to get people to click on things by mistake. Edit: PLEASE let us turn rufus off entirely. I do NOT want it eating I my screen space and data.

this app is genuinely falling apart. bad search feature, slow, like 30 second load times slow, and just outright refuses to load sometimes. even if the app worked, their main services don't. I've ordered several packages that just don't show up. or show up in someone else's bushes. or on top of a car. if you try to get a refund, they just won't give it to you. 3-5 business days doesn't mean I have to wait 7 business days to not get a refund. still haven't gotten one. I'm done

App needs to sort orders by arrival date. I shouldnt have to scroll items delivered to find items I am still waiting on. Additionally, there should be a sort option for undelivered by expected delivery date. i.e. "What's expected to be delivered today". You should also have a "make a suggestion" on the "contact us" app page

App is so slow now. It takes forever to switch between sizes and colors of items. Also won't load "my orders" tab on app to check order status or return an item, or check on a return. I need to download the QR codes to do free Kohl's drop off but it won't show me the orders! It has been doing this for months! It either says "something went wrong" or just doesn't load at all. Also no one asked for an annoying AI bot.

Of all the run-ins I've had with Amazon issues, I never felt compelled to complain. However, in the last week or so, the app is lagging so badly I want to throw my phone. It skips and jerks the screen up and down, I can't select anything because it takes forever to make images available, and when I scroll it, doesn't move. I try again, nothing, then suddenly the screen FLIES BY at rocket speeds. I don't know what you did, Amazon, but UNDO IT!

The cancelation process in this app is ridiculous. It will not allow an order cancelation on high ticket items. They will ship the item, forcing you to do a return that will be UPS pick-up only. The UPS pick-up takes days to show with UPS and it will show a failed attempt "Business is closed". When you finally call and get ahold of someone they tell you it "should" be refunded, there's nothing I can do, you'll have to call back in 5-7 business days.

Two issues need to be fixed. First, mouse support for tablets is lacking. If you click on the shopping cart, it goes to your orders. If you tap the cart instead it goes to your cart (Bug). Second, Rufus popping up on every product page is annoying. Amazon customer since 2002. I spend TON$ on Amazon, even purchasing Amazon internationally. I've reviewed MANY purchases. However, Amazon admins have been CENSORING any review I leave that is negative.

CANNOT DISABLE RUFUS. This 1 star rating will remain until you put an option to disable this infernal piece of garbage A.I. instead of forcing it down our throats! Whatever happened to customer choice? We should have the ability to disable it. It's intrusive, I hate it. It's always popping up at the most inconvenient times and now shopping is frustrating. Now I have to go through the tedious & risky process of downloading an older version of Amazon from a 3rd party app store. Thumbs down.

Hate new and extra layered levels & pop out things on a cell phone! Way more annoying than convenient. It mostly just gets in the way when trying to click on a different layer or scroll thru search results. Y'all also pushing items like an ugly incel looking for sex! We're already here to shop! Stop being so pushy & forceful! Hate the new double slide out menus, hate the new Alexa option. Let me turn them off & Get them out of the way! Yep, now rufus even more in the way, pops out constantly :(

I made an account with my real email and have had trouble ever since the account was started. I couldn't get Amazon prime, order items, ECT. Amazon then kicks me out of my account when I try to buy a cable for my hard drive and game pass for Xbox. After hours of trying to log in and getting hit with the "Looking for something" page a dozen times I made an account with my fake email. I buy the items again and GET MY ACCOUNT SUSPENDED. I want my original account back or to unsuspend my account.

Wish there was a way to tell Amazon I already have a package as a costumer. If what I read is true, and me getting my money back makes me believe it, the seller doesn't get my money until it updates. Like I've already reviewed the product but it hasn't update. It's not the sellers fault that the shipper, USPS in my case, lost track. Like this all could be solved with a button and me sending a picture of the product.

They're only supposed to take money AFTER the item ships, but they take it BEFORE and when you try to ask what's up with that, they send you to an automated chat assistant that doesn't let you explain the situation and doesn't help AT ALL. Crooks. Jeff Bezos is a crook. Why am I paying almost 20 bucks a month for a subscription to this thing if shipping takes a week instead of the one to two days promised when paying the subscription fee? I'm canceling my subscription, complete and utter nonsens

Terrible update. Just because you can change the design, doesn't mean you should. Focus your energy on fixing your search engine. It's Terrible. Sadly, when I need to find something that Amazon can't find. I search for it on Google and just like magic, there's the item on Amazon. Update 6/24. Exactly 1 year and it still sucks. Now they added an AI shove it down your throat button to an already crowed bar with no option to remove.

Recent changes are horrible. I used to love shopping on Amazon. However, now when I search the results are not what I am looking for. It's becoming increasingly difficult to search for a specific item or brand because the results promote other items. The latest changes have ruined Warehouse searches. There are maybe three warehouse items in the results mixed in with a ton of "sponsored" listings. Stop being so greedy, Amazon, its tacky and annoying. Maybe I need to cancel prime.

This app has definitely got issues, after using it for any length if time it enlarges the pictures to where it's unuseable without rebooting my phone! Hate what you've done to the navigation of this app, changing my settings is really not going to make me happy! Stop adding more buttons associated with other functions, I don't need or want to spend half of my time shutting down the app because of the way it's set up! I'm running the June update on my other phone with flawless perfection!

I love using Amazon to do all kinds of shopping but the recent addition of the Rufus AI is absolutely awful. The fact that you can't turn it off or opt out is so stupid, it's useless and clutters up the screen. It's always in the way when you're trying to look at anything at all and you have to keep. Exiting. Out. For every single thing you look at or it will give a ton of "helpful" search suggestions when you scroll. Not to mention it monitoring your online activity with the regular search

Why AI? I've used the amazon shopping app for years and years, but this latest update with AI is phenomenally annoying. The thing keeps popping up when I'm trying to look at descriptions and specs and wastes far too much of the screen the rest of the time. The thing is making it less enjoyable to use the platform. If AI is something that Amazon really wants to push, PLEASE make an option to turn off that search feature for those of us who don't want it.

In my personal experience. Everything that Amazon prime has to offer. There's is no value. I honestly have nothing good to say. All the services are bad and misleading. Worst part about shopping through them is they give you search results that you are not searching for! Too many ads are distracting and makes it very confusing while searching. Resulting in me shopping elsewhere.

Useless app with the release of Rufus AI. The pop up menu is intrusive and continues to pop up as I'm trying to look through product descriptions, resulting in the inability to see the product. You slide it down, but as soon as you click on another item, Rufus is back and taking up valuable screen space. Amazon has given us no way to turn it off at this time making the app frustrating and useless. Guess that means less time I spend searching and buying products on Amazon. 🤷🏼‍♀️

If I search for something on Amazon, I suddenly get ads for that thing all over the internet and other apps. I thought I had the setting for this turned off, but it still happens every time. This is creepy and annoying. Reviews are not trustworthy on Amazon, and if you try to sort by best sellers, it's not actually sorted that way. I used to love using Amazon, but I usually try to find items elsewhere now.

Amazon has been sliding drastically in quality. It is not reliable anymore. Ordered items change their shipping date without reason up to 3 times before it is allowed to be canceled. So when ordering it will say '2 day shipping', but after ordering it will change up to 3 times making it weeks or months later than shown when ordering. If this is a problem as you needed the item when expected, you are not allowed to cancel as the items are 'shipping'. They are holding our money hostage.

Nothing wrong with the app itself. This review is for Amazon. Not sure what's going on with you guys. I've made various purchases from June 15th to now June 27th. And I've had trouble over and over. First I receive broken/damaged items, then I get sent the wrong items twice. And we don't get an exchange option unless we have a credit card. So if we only use a debit card, we have to go do the return first, wait 3 days for refund and order again. Do better!!

This app has become another terrible app. There are way too many things trying to load when the app first loads up. The AI that is forced on us causes the app to take even longer to load. The AI loads faster than your search, pops up, and starts talking to about the items you searched that are still loading. Now, I dread using your app. It's easier for me to find what I am looking for on a search engine and buy it from a different store. Your service bo longer has any value to me.

The latest update is SO annoying. This whole Rufus AI gets in the way anytime I try to scroll down to see more information on an item. People want a way to turn this feature off. Or place it somewhere else on the screen so as not to keep accidentally pressing it. Also, when switching between different size or color options now, the app glitches out and takes two or three attempts to simply load a different color/size of an item. Troubleshoot before another update. This is mediocre.

The application itself is fine. However, the deliveries are getting worse as time goes on. They have constantly delivered to the wrong house despite the giant #s on each house and mine being the only yellow one. USPS, UPS, FedEx, and OnTrack never get it wrong. When the packages are time sensitive, these mistakes are inexcusable especially when deliveries use to be accurate. Why am i paying for Prime if i have to reorder half of the time? I'll be looking at other options for my deliveries.

Amazon used to be good but now they're pretty bad. I ordered something with Prime and even paid extra for same day shipping. It's been delayed twice already. The app says I can cancel if I want since it's late, but there's no cancel button. After a long search, I finally get to an option to cancel, but the app says I can't cancel because the package is in its way. Last few deliveries have been delayed. It has became a headache to use this app that, at one point, was very convenient.

This app is awful since they added their "Rufus AI". I didn't ask for it! Though, I could care less if I could disable it, or if it wasn't shoved down my throat to begin with. Every time I click to view an item, this AI thing generates bunch of questions that I can ask it about the item, and that in itself takes up a small portion of my screen, and so I have to close it myself every time (this is exhausting). Additionally, I can bet that this AI thing is collecting my data without my consent.

Up until the most recent update, I've had no major issues with using Amazon's app. Their search has always been sloppy, but nothing that stopped the use of the app. Now, with most recent update, Amazon has added their useless and annoying AI, Rufus. Every item you look at now, there is Rufus at the bottom. Yes, you can close it by swiping the AI bar down. But the second you look at another item, it's right back in your face and Amazon does not give you a way to disable it. AI should be optional.

THE UI SUCKS!!! This app has a higher rating than it deserves. It is incredibly slow, cluttered with too much filler on-screen, the important features like filters are too small, THERE IS NO DARK MODE STILL, and so much more need to be fixed. When viewing products themselves,why does it take so long go get to the reviews? Stop showing me other products and show me what I need to know. It's pathetic, and Amazon is one of the richest companies in the world with the best people working for them??

I love amazon, I really do, but the new list ui sucks. It was way better two updates ago. All I want is all my lists in one place, not behind a tiny "see all" button. I can't organize my saved items in the lists easily if the first thing that is thrown at me is the recent section. The new ui as a whole just kinda went backward.

Both the app and the service used to be stellar. Now Amazon regularly loses shipments, then makes you wait multiple days before you can request a refund or reshipment. The app sharing link often shares a link that simply does not work. This is a shame, because Amazon has become a necessity for so many items. However their inability to address lost or stolen packages is extremely discouraging, and promoting me to just start buying items directly from a seller.

One month now I have ordered the same items 3 x and all 3x they failed to deliver. One month has almost gone by and I have yet to receive one item. My money has been in Amazon account for almost one month. I'm done with laundering my money and no benefits. Postal gone POSTAL and the CS so busy apologizing the issue is NEVER solved. This will be my last and I know quite a few others going gone as well.

It's shocking that a multi-trillion dollar app based company has such a mediocre app. The biggest issue is it can't handle any volume, which is problematic when you introduce a grocery delivery service where people will inevitably be ordering dozens of items. I spent half an hour trying to change my tip. I finally submitted my order, then went back to adjust the tip. It took multiple attempts to do this. Clearly no one designing this app has ever ordered groceries on it.🤦‍♂️

TIP: turn off open supported links, open amazon in browser, and add the webpage to home screen. Then uninstall this app. With every "helpful" addition, the app is more cluttered and unintuitive. Rufus is unnecessary and ridiculous. Make it an icon to click within the search bar, should people WANT to use it, but allow opt-out/turn off. Settings menu is full of shopping icons now, which is a disaster and distracting. Inspire should also be optional. Some of us aren't interested or made of money.

The AI button and pop up for every item is SUPER ANNOYING! I find myself using the app for less time than before because I get too annoyed. Wish there was a way to customize the buttons at the bottom of the main screen so the ones each person uses most can be added/removed. Wastes prescious screen space and takes too many wasted finger movements.

I tried buying two items. My card was locked at the time, but when i unlocked it to update payment, it just added a different order with the same items. So I canceled one of the orders and tried getting a hold of support. There is basically no option to talk about whatever with a real person unless you look into subcategories, which I find dumb. After some time, I got support, and they said they'd be able to reorder the order that got canceled. I was supposed to get an email but haven't so far.

It's been very laggy lately. Photo reviews are a struggle to view. Listing photos don't load unless you open in full view. Fake products. Irrelevant search results. Limited filtering options. Amazon has declined. Edited 6/30/24: It's really starting to feel like Amazon is intentionally making their app and website worse. The search function regularly shows me only overpriced, poor quality items. The filters are shadowing listings too. I'm cancelling my prime membership.

They took a definitive step back with this build. Can't clearly see what still has not been delivered and there is no way to filter it for those. Also I am searching on Amazon to shop, not to use Amazon like Google. Questions popping up where there should be listing is tedious. Please revert to previous build. Usually I have not problems with the app. Edit: The ai is even worse now and I want to be able to turn it off, I don't like it and would prefer triditional browsing.

You're getting 1 star because of Rufus. This has appeared in my app, and it is annoying. The interface pops up and gets in my way. HOW DO I DISABLE IT??? Give me the option to turn it on or off. I am so annoyed by almost every program I use, shoving a new, annoying AI in my face. Ask my permission before turning it on! Once I can disable it, I’ll change my review.

I can't make a purchase!! It asks during checkout about joining Prime, and then no matter how I answer...I can't get past that page!! 😫 Same thing is actually happening when I open Amazon with a Chrome browser on my phone as well! Android user & I have the latest update. Couldn't figure out how to leave feedback in the app either. Normally, I'm happy with the app for the most part.

Can't follow delivery instructions, always missing packages. Too many poor quality products with artificial ratings/fake reviews that I can't even bother to shop online anymore. The shipping and packaging is so wasteful, even when I select the "less boxes." Amazon Fresh isn't a bulk grocery store, but you have to buy 4 of the same item to get the "deals". I'm already paying a membership and I don't want to bulk buy, especially perishables. And I haven't met anyone who enjoys working there.

The new update is awful. Things don't save to my favorites list, it's glitchy and weird. The navigation is all different for no reason. It was perfectly fine before, I don't know what the purpose was of switching everything around. I can literally add something to my favorite list over and over and it still will not appear, yet it says it's in my list. Horrible update.

Recently, amazon had "prime" days where they claimed great deals. Now, like most people, I checked it out. I have never seen a more blatant lie all in one place! Every single item I had saved or been looking at had been at the same price, but next to each price, they had a claim the actual price was much higher! You're kidding right? I have been watching these items for a long time. We're not all stupid and ignorant. I've been losing faith in this option for a while, this is disrespectful

No dark mode | Even more clutter in the bottom bar, makes me dislike using the app | Still doesn't have dark mode. | I'm clicking the wrong button all the time. Please fix it. | The new update ruins the experience by putting an Inspiration tab right where you would click to go to see your orders. I constantly click it by accident. | Previous version review for a long time: Great redesign, allows for multi tab browsing. And it doesn't freeze like the old version

great until this past month where the app will randomly freeze, not allow me to click anything, have the little red/yellow bar at the top loading, I can't search anything or scroll. makes it impossible to use the app if I have to close it and restart it again every 5 minutes. I've cleared cache and storage, app is updated, uninstalled and reinstalled. would be 5 stars but I can't even use it? help would be APPRECIATED 👍

Overall, it is a good shopping app, but I am very disappointed that there is no add to list option. I always create a Christmas shopping list for my 4 kiddos, but now there is no way to do so, I have tried the app, I have tried just using the online website, and it is just impossible. You can still create a wishlist when viewing your other lists, but when looking at products there is no heart to click to add to your list, and the "add to list" button is also gone. This needs to be fixed ASAP.

The app it's self and convenience is great. The only reason for 2 stars is because I can't completely disable Rufus. Im not gonna use it and don't want it popping up every time I select things, it also gets in the way of selectable options and really is of no use. I'm not sure why every company has to force "AI" into everything but it's getting old.

No variety?? 300M products yet it only shows me the same 20 things again. The marketplace is saturated by knockoffs and you don't even know it's from another country till you receive it in the mail direct (and unregulated) from China. The search could really use work: Seller rating, Products made/located in US if I don't want to roll the dice on getting unregulated junk merchandise. Need filters to separate legit goods from knockoffs! Searches are 90% 'featured' products. Reviews are 98% fake
